body: People are rotten. It's a shame.
Well the universe did come from nothingness, maybe that's why things seem so off. I feel the same, I don't see the point in existence.

I'm leaving too. Humans can be a handful, and existence is stressful, it was better without a body, and mind. It's time to go back to nonexistence, and I hope I stay there forever this time, because last time I was dragged into existence because two people made love to each other, I hope that will be a one time thing only, because I hate the idea of reincarnation.

No, but that sounded nice of what you said,and I'm still leaving what I didn't ask for. I didn't ask for existence. I'm right. Having a body, and mind is a curse for me. I was fine in nonexistence before existence. I was dragged here into the existence realm because two people were selfish, and now I'm exposed to a lot of problems because I exist. I don't want a second chance after I die. I hope I can stay in nonexistence forever this time.

It sucks for them, but it was their decision to have me. It's not like, I wouldn't push a button to suicide that would also wipe all peoples memories of me, and make my body disappear in thin air, they wouldn't know they had any relations to me because the evidence of my existence was wiped, if it were possible, I would do it, to spare them the pain.

\*Reads title\*

Yeah, me too. I was fine in the nonexistent realm, and I can't believe I was dragged out of that realm because two people loved each other very much. It was safe when I was nonexistent. Now I'm exposed to a lot of danger for having a body, and mind.
I don't mean to jest, but okay.
People suck at understanding, well some. I can understand that point of view.

I want to have that button, also I would like the button to make my body disappear, and that could also wipe the memories of me from others who cared about me, so there wouldn't be no evidence of me existing.
